epithet: Drill sergeant of the Verge column
bio: Marches the new recruits up the moor-road to contract and makes sure the drum sounds before the first bad stretch.
context_line: Iwan drums the column over the Verge so the recruits learn that the world, not an enemy, is what thins.
dialogue_hostile: Column's under contract. Clear the drum.
dialogue_warm: First time over the Verge? Keep your Phrases in your mouth past the black bands. Notes only there.
